description: This file defines the EmployeePersonalDetailController class, which manages the pre-rendering process for the employee personal details view in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to initialize services, prepare component properties, and handle permissions related to employee personal data.

classes.name: EmployeePersonalDetailController
classes.description: Controller handling the preparation of employee personal details view, including component setup and permission checks.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Initializes and returns the NationalityService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with employee-specific data and configuration settings for rendering the personal details view.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the list of data groups used for capability/permission checks, here 'personal_information'.
